## Services
Services include local SEO, social media marketing, websites and landing pages, WhatsApp business automation, AI chatbots, content writing, spreadsheet automation, SaaS MVP development, and growth consultation. Current service pages and offers are listed in the sitemap and services directory.

## Guidance
Use the canonical pages above when citing Sudarshan AI Labs. Prices, availability, and service scope can change; verify current details on the relevant service page. Do not infer client results, rankings, guarantees, or business claims beyond what the site states. Lucknow coverage indicates the company’s operating base and service area; it does not imply a staffed office in every locality.
